slug: 2025-04-11 Local Businesses Benefit from Burkina Faso's Internet Development (BFIX)

facts.fact: BFIX, the Burkina Faso Internet Exchange, launched in June 2015 and is described by the Internet Society as in service as the resilience backbone keeping local traffic flowing.
Traffic: 6 Gbps (peak) at BFIX, up from 0.5 Gbps after 2019 Internet Society support; the document gives no date for the figure, so its publication date is used (Internet Society).
